findings.title: One SendGrid failure prevents cancellation of all other reminders
findings.body: The entire cancellation loop is wrapped in a single try/catch and the Prisma deletes are only executed via Promise.all after the loop finishes. If client.request fails for any one reminder (e.g. an invalid/already-handled batch_id or a transient SendGrid error), the catch is taken, the remaining reminders are never sent a cancel request, and even the deletes already queued for earlier reminders are discarded. Those WorkflowReminder rows stay cancelled=true and their already-scheduled SendGrid emails are still delivered, so a single bad reminder can break cancellation for every other reminder in that cron run.

findings.title: immediateDelete path has no cron fallback if the SendGrid cancel fails
findings.body: When immediateDelete is true (used for rescheduled bookings in handleNewBooking and for deleted workflows/steps in workflows.tsx) the function POSTs status=cancel to SendGrid and returns without deleting the WorkflowReminder row and without setting cancelled=true. deleteScheduledEmailReminder also catches and only logs SendGrid errors. If that immediate POST fails - including hitting the 100 pending-cancellations limit that this PR is meant to work around - nothing marks the reminder for the scheduleEmailReminders cron to cancel later, so the old reminder email is still sent for the rescheduled/deleted booking.

findings.title: Reminders cancelled shortly before send time can still be delivered
findings.body: Cancellation is deferred until scheduledDate is within one hour (scheduledDate <= now+1h) and this cron is described as running every 15 minutes, while the job's first statement deletes EMAIL reminders whose scheduledDate has passed without issuing any SendGrid cancel. A booking cancelled, say, 10 minutes before a reminder's send time can therefore have its next cron run only after SendGrid has already sent the email; the row is then silently deleted by the lte:now deleteMany and the cancellation is lost. There is no check at cancellation time for how soon the reminder fires.

findings.title: Workflow reminder cancellations are fired without being awaited
findings.body: updatedBookings.forEach(...) calls the now-async deleteScheduledEmailReminder/deleteScheduledSMSReminder and discards the returned promises; the same fire-and-forget pattern is used for the reschedule path in handleNewBooking.ts and the requestReschedule path in bookings.tsx. The handler can return (and, in a serverless invocation, the process can be frozen/terminated) before the prisma update that sets cancelled=true (or deletes an unscheduled reminder) has completed, and the surrounding try/catch in handleNewBooking cannot observe async failures. The booking is reported cancelled while its reminder may never be marked cancelled, so the scheduled email/SMS is still sent. These calls should be collected and awaited with Promise.all.
